module: D10-14 Industrial Policy／Subsidy／Geopolitical Bottleneck產業政策補貼與地緣瓶頸
purpose: Establish a replayable Taiwan-issuer industrial-policy-to-physical-capacity lifecycle using TSMC Arizona CHIPS award and facility milestones.

policyLifecycle.note: Preliminary terms were non-binding and subject to due diligence and milestones.

policyLifecycle.milestoneRule: Direct funding is disbursed based on construction, production and commercial milestones; loans relate to capital expenditures.

policyLifecycle.evidence: First Arizona fab entered high-volume production.
Second fab structure completed; facility systems being installed.
Current official Arizona site shows initial construction stages for additional fab/advanced-packaging expansion and expanded long-run investment plans.

positiveMechanism: Industrial incentives can reduce effective project financing burden and support geographic capacity relocation/expansion when tied to verified milestones.
Milestone-based disbursement provides an observable policy-to-construction-to-production chain rather than a headline-only subsidy variable.
TSMC issuer-native facility milestones allow policy and physical-capacity clocks to be replayed separately.
negativeControls: A final award of up to US$6.6bn does not mean US$6.6bn was immediately disbursed; actual disbursement remains UNKNOWN unless disclosed.
Final award does not equal usable capacity: only Fab 1 is HVM while later fabs are construction/installation/future-HVM states.
Subsidized geographic expansion can carry higher overseas manufacturing cost and execution risk; subsidy is not automatically margin accretive.
The award is issuer/facility specific and cannot be generalized to all Taiwan semiconductor companies.
Capacity timing is driven by customer demand, construction, equipment, qualification and ramp, not policy award alone.

pitContract.unit: issuer × facility × policy program × milestone vintage
pitContract.revisionRule: Append award amendments and facility milestone changes; never backdate future HVM.
pitContract.outcomeFirewall: No stock, margin or valuation outcome is opened while freezing policy/capacity state.

redundancyControls: D10-04 owns physical capacity lifecycle; D10-14 owns the policy cause/conditions and its link to capacity.
D09-14 owns issuer strategic-action lifecycle; policy support is contextual input, not a duplicate action vote.
D13 owns macro industrial-policy/regime context; D10-14 owns facility-level supply-chain transmission.
promotionReason: Official Commerce award terms plus issuer-native TSMC Arizona facility milestones create a replayable award-to-capacity dataset with explicit maximum-vs-disbursement and award-vs-HVM firewalls.
reasonNoL4: No prospective/OOS test establishes whether subsidy-linked facility states improve future margins, returns or stock selection after controlling for demand, capex, cost, capacity and valuation.
exactNext: SC-048 append actual disbursement/loan/tax-credit figures only when issuer/government sources disclose them; otherwise remain UNKNOWN.
Add a second Taiwan issuer/program policy-to-capacity case before cross-company inference.
Preregister prospective tests of policy-supported capacity versus unsubsidized/less-subsidized comparable expansions.
